nodes.description: A hemizygous germline missense variant in AVPR2 on Xq28, the gene encoding the arginine vasopressin V2 receptor. The reported alleles are a small set of activating substitutions: the two original codon-137 changes (arginine to cysteine, R137C, and to leucine, R137L), the transmembrane substitution F229V, and I130N. Codon 137 shows allelic opposition - R137H at the same residue is loss-of-function and causes X-linked nephrogenic diabetes insipidus, whereas R137C and R137L are gain-of-function.

nodes.description: The I130N receptor adopts a biased conformation whose basal activity does not recruit beta-arrestin, yet the receptor is constitutively internalized through a dynamin-dependent, beta-arrestin-independent route. The genotype sets the inability to excrete free water; the load supplies the water.
